solutionData.generation_method: This solution was found using a hybrid optimization approach combining a Genetic Algorithm (GA) with a local search refinement step. The GA ran for 1000 generations with a population size of 500. Each generation involved selection (tournament selection), crossover (uniform crossover with 70% probability), and mutation (flipping a coefficient with 1% probability). The best individuals from each generation were then subjected to a local search, where single coefficient flips were tested for improvement. The polynomial's peak-to-RMS ratio was evaluated using FFT on 100,000 points on the unit circle. This specific set of coefficients yielded a score of 1.889047970701196.
